__doc__: Operator-editable policy, kept OUT of the code. Copy to clipeus.tuning.json (beside clipeus.py), or point $CLIPEUS_TUNING at it, or drop it in ~/.config/clipeus/tuning.json. Any key you omit falls back to the in-code default, so a partial file is fine and the tool always runs standalone. Run `clipeus --show-config` to see what actually loaded. Brand/engagement policy (approved_mx, approved_redirect, brand_keywords, resolvers, nsec3) lives separately in brand.json / --config.
